core_categories: Laboratory Equipment; Consumables and Reagents; Industrial MRO Supplies; Hospital and Nursing Care Equipment; Cleanroom Products; Facility Furniture
specialty_focus: AS ONE Corporation is a Japanese manufacturer and wholesale distributor providing a comprehensive range of research instruments, laboratory consumables, industrial MRO supplies, and hospital/nursing care equipment. It specializes in supporting research and biotechnology, life sciences, nanotechnology, and food safety testing, with a focus on contamination control through its proprietary ASPURE brand. The company is known for just-in-time B2B distribution, offering a vast digital catalog and e-commerce platform (AXEL GLOBAL) to supply even single niche items promptly.
